US Congress.title: Congress.gov Notifications Join us Tomorrow for the 2026 Congress.gov Public Forum
US Congress.summary: We are pleased to announce that we are holding a Congress.gov Public Forum in the Mumford Room, which is located in the Library of Congress Madison Building, on September 24, 2026, from 1-3 p.m. EDT. During the forum, we will provide you with an update on the enhancements that have been made to the site over the past year, many of which have been inspired by your feedback. And, as in past years, you will have the opportunity to provide the Library and our data partners with your feedback about how we can better serve your legislative information needs. If you would like to submit feedback ahead of the public forum, please use our Congress.gov Public Forum Survey Form . You can register to attend this free event in-person here . If you prefer, you can participate online by registering here .
